faq_heading: Homes near Josette Dandurand Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Josette Dandurand Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Langley School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Josette Dandurand Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Josette Dandurand Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Josette Dandurand Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Peter Ewart Middle School (1.0 km south), Yorkson Creek Middle School (1.1 km east) and Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary (1.1 km south-east).

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Josette Dandurand Elementary

15 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Josette Dandurand Elementary in a straight line (11 elementary, 2 middle, 2 secondary; 0 independent). The closest is Peter Ewart Middle School, 1.0 km away, and the farthest on this list is James Kennedy Elementary, 2.7 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary (1.1 km); the nearest secondary school is R E Mountain Secondary (1.2 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Alex Hope Elementary (2.1 km). Other elementary schools close by: Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary (1.1 km south-east), Willoughby Elementary (1.4 km south-east), Dorothy Peacock Elementary (1.7 km north), Lynn Fripps Elementary (1.8 km east), Richard Bulpitt Elementary (1.9 km south-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-5) is Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary, 1.1 km south-east of Josette Dandurand Elementary.
